start: ^They speak of him in the palaces as if he were a tactical problem to be mapped out and solved.
^They did not see the graves open. They do not know what it feels like to have seven demons wrenched out of your mind by a single word.
^My memory is the only anchor I have left, and I will not look away from it.

s: ^Are you not afraid of the high priest's guards?
^What does he mean when he speaks of his upcoming departure?

fear: ^Fear is a clothing I took off a long time ago. Let them watch the house. The stone has already been rolled away from my past; they cannot lock me back inside it.
departure: ^He speaks in shadows, but his eyes look straight through the horizon. He is preparing us for a night where there will be no lanterns to follow.
